desc: "It's Sam's show now." After 9 years and over 500 startups, Y Combinator cofounder Paul Graham is stepping back as president.  In his fireside chat at LAUNCH Festival, PG told Jason why he's handing the reigns to Sam Altman, entrepreneur from YC's first batch. That summer in Boston, Sam was joined by Alexis Ohanian and Steve Huffman of Reddit, Justin Kan and Emmett Shear who later founded Twitch.t
